resources.string: Simulates many Eddystone-UID beacons with one shared Namespace ID and sequential Instance IDs, for testing the Abeeway BLE sniffer.
Shared by every simulated beacon, e.g. 0102030405060708090A.
Instance IDs are 0x…9001…N. Lower dwell + more parallel advertisers = faster full sweep. Most phones only allow a few parallel advertisers; extras self-retire and the rest cover all beacons.
Each unique beacon is broadcast at least this many times within the sniffer scan window. The app derives the required interval and computes the dwell time and number of advertisers automatically.
